title.rendered: Kaduna senator hails Tinubu for retaining Shettima as running mate

content.rendered:
The Senator representing Kaduna South Senatorial District, Sunday Katung, has welcomed the re-nomination of Vice President Kashim Shettima as President Bola Tinubu’s running mate for the 2027 presidential election, describing the decision as a reward for loyalty, competence and dedicated service.

Katung said Tinubu’s decision to retain Shettima reflected his confidence in the VP’s leadership qualities and contributions to the implementation of the administration’s Renewed Hope Agenda.

The lawmaker made the remarks in a statement issued on Sunday by his Special Adviser on Media and Communications, Midat Joseph.

According to Katung, Shettima has remained a dependable partner to the President by providing “steady support and valuable counsel” in the administration of the country over the past three years.

He said, “The re-nomination is a clear testament to Vice President Shettima’s loyalty, competence and unwavering commitment to the Renewed Hope Agenda of the present administration.

“Over the last three years, the Vice President has provided steady support and valuable counsel in piloting the affairs of the nation.”

The senator also commended Tinubu for reposing confidence in his deputy, saying the decision underscored the President’s recognition of Shettima’s experience, strategic insight and contributions to governance.

He added that the renewed Tinubu-Shettima partnership would reassure Nigerians of continuity and stability as the administration continues to pursue economic reforms and address the country’s security challenges.

“The decision reflects Mr President’s recognition of the Vice President’s experience, strategic insight and invaluable contributions to governance, national unity and the overall progress of the country,” Katung said.

He expressed optimism that the administration would record greater progress in infrastructure development, human capital development and inclusive economic growth if re-elected.

Katung also prayed for God’s guidance, wisdom and protection for both the President and the Vice President as they continue to lead the country.

Reaffirming his support for the All Progressives Congress presidential ticket, the senator called on Nigerians to unite behind the administration in its efforts to build a stronger and more prosperous nation.

“The renewed partnership between President Tinubu and Vice President Shettima gives Nigerians renewed assurance of continuity, stability and purposeful leadership. Their combined experience remains critical at this time when the administration is consolidating key economic reforms and security gains,” he added.

The APC recently endorsed Tinubu as its sole presidential candidate for the 2027 presidential election, while Shettima was retained as his running mate.

Shettima, a former governor of Borno State and ex-senator, was first nominated as Tinubu’s running mate ahead of the 2023 presidential election. Both leaders were inaugurated on May 29, 2023, and have since driven the Federal Government’s Renewed Hope Agenda, which focuses on reforms in the economy, infrastructure, social investment and security.

Katung, who chairs the Senate Committee on the North West Development Commission, has consistently supported the Tinubu administration’s policies and repeatedly urged Nigerians to back ongoing reforms aimed at stabilising the economy and improving national security.
